# City of Abbotsford

> Municipal government portal providing comprehensive waste management, city services, emergency alerts, and data analytics tools for Abbotsford residents.

The City of Abbotsford website serves as the primary digital hub for municipal services, with a strong emphasis on waste diversion programs, curbside collection scheduling, and online service portals. The site integrates emergency alert systems, open data resources, and interactive mapping tools to support residents and businesses.

## Core Municipal Services

- [Home | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca): City of Abbotsford homepage with municipal services and information
- [City Services | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/city-services): City of Abbotsford municipal services directory and information hub
- [MyCity Online | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/city-services/mycity-online): MyCity Online dashboard for permits, recreation, utility bills, taxes

## Waste Management & Recycling

- [Recycling, Compost & Garbage | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/recycling-compost-garbage): Curbside collection program for recycling, compost, and garbage services
- [Collection Schedule | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/collection-schedule): Weekly and bi-weekly curbside collection schedule for Abbotsford
- [What Goes Where | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/recycling-compost-garbage/what-goes-where): Waste Wizard tool and guide for proper recycling and disposal sorting
- [Missed Collection | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/recycling-compost-garbage/missed-collection): Troubleshooting guide for common missed waste collection issues
- [Transfer Stations & Recycling Depots | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/transferstations): Locations for waste drop-off at transfer stations and recycling depots
- [Glass Recycling | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/glass): Glass recycling program guidelines and waste diversion information

## Waste Reduction & Environmental Programs

- [Contamination Remediation Plan | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/CRP): 2025 Contamination Remediation Plan to reduce recycling contamination by 25%
- [Waste Reduction Initiatives | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/reducewaste): Household waste reduction strategies and sustainability initiatives
- [Yard Waste Coupon | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/yardwaste): Yard waste coupon program for free drop-off at Pacific Coast Renewables
- [Excess Waste | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/excesswaste): Guidelines for managing excess waste and meeting waste diversion goals
- [Wildlife and Waste | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/recycling-compost-garbage/wildlife-and-waste): Wildlife safety tips for managing waste around bears, coyotes, raccoons

## Data, Mapping & Analytics

- [Mapping, Data, and Analytics | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/city-services/mapping-data-analytics): Open Data Hub and Abbotsford WAY mapping and analytics tools
- [WebMap | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/city-services/mapping-data-analytics/webmap): Interactive WebMap tool for geographic information and city data

## Optional

- [Update on Rainfall Warning | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/alerts/update-rainfall-warning): Emergency weather alert: rainfall warning update from Environment Canada
- [Multi-Family & ICI Information | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/mficiwaste): Waste management information for multi-family and commercial properties
- [Abbotsford-Mission Recycling Depot | City of Abbotsford](https://www.abbotsford.ca/amrd): Information about Abbotsford-Mission Recycling Depot facility
